name: 25 further employers — complete public boards
description: Twenty-five additional employers with complete public listing inventories, using unlimited deterministic traversal and differing language editions where needed. Local validation is paired with GitHub production evidence. Blocked employers are excluded; source records include translations and are not a unique-vacancy census.
